description: This source file defines the LaunchAgentManager enum which manages the setup, removal, and control of a macOS launch agent plist, including generating plist contents, starting, stopping, and checking the status of the launch agent.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if the launch agent plist is present and if the launchctl command reports it is loaded.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables the launch agent by writing the plist file and running the appropriate launchctl commands.

methods.name: writePlist
methods.description: Creates and writes the launch agent plist file with the specified bundle path.

methods.name: plistContents
methods.description: Returns the XML content of the plist as a string, given the bundle path.

methods.name: runLaunchctl
methods.description: Runs the 'launchctl' command with the supplied arguments asynchronously and returns the process's termination status.
